title: Scenario JSON serialization pot field float/int type instability
original_failing_reproduction: PokerScenario.from_dict({'pot': 10, ...}).to_dict() produced pot=10.0, causing canonical hash mismatch in roundtrip
corrected_invariant: Integer pot values preserve int type; float values preserve float type; serialization roundtrip is bitwise deterministic

title: Assessment item bank unsafe default validation_status fallback
original_failing_reproduction: AssessmentItemBank._index_pack_items defaulted missing validation_status to 'VALIDATED', making unvalidated packs authoritative
corrected_invariant: Missing or non-VALIDATED status strictly fails closed: is_quarantined=True, supported_tiers=[], validation_status reflects actual or MISSING_VALIDATION_STATUS

title: Contradictory scenario metadata extraction preflight ordering
original_failing_reproduction: Packs with contradictory game_type / tournament metadata crashed in node_extractor.extract_node before quarantine logic was reached
corrected_invariant: Metadata validation precedes node extraction; contradictory packs are immediately quarantined without calling extractor

title: Tournament ICM/CSTE categorical grading quarantine
original_failing_reproduction: Tournament CSTE decisions were reported with cash-game categorical grades (e.g. STRONG) without mathematical prize-pool calibration
corrected_invariant: Raw CSTE action regret is numerically preserved; categorical grade is strictly UNGRADED with status CSTE_POLICY_PENDING

title: Cash grading regret integrity vs frequency override
original_failing_reproduction: Speculative report claimed 0.1679 chips EV loss received STRONG due to frequency >= 20%
corrected_invariant: Raw EV loss > 0.10 chips strictly assigns ACCEPTABLE; frequency never overrides raw mathematical regret

title: Playwright analytics test skip on missing ground-truth fixture
original_failing_reproduction: analytics_data_integrity.spec.ts skipped when profile e0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001 was missing from DB
corrected_invariant: Canonical ground-truth fixture seeded into PostgreSQL; both tests execute and pass live with zero skips

title: Rust evaluator ignored tests verification in Linux release container
original_failing_reproduction: verify_all_five_card_hands_vs_reference was marked #[ignore] due to debug slowness on host
corrected_invariant: Exhaustive evaluation of all 2,598,960 5-card hands and 1M random 7-card hands verified against naive combinatorial oracle with 0 mismatches
